Help-center excerpts:

[disputes-pending] Why can't I dispute a pending transaction? (effective 2025-01-01)
any more charges. When the transaction posts, dispute it as unauthorized. Your dispute window starts from the statement it posts on, so you won't lose time by waiting.

## If the amount is wrong

Pending amounts are often estimates, for example at gas pumps or hotels. The posted amount is usually different. Wait and see what posts.

## If it's been pending a long time

Some merchants take longer. If a transaction has been pending much longer than usual, message support and we'll look at it.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any

[disputes-duplicate] Charged twice for the same thing (effective 2025-01-01)
Seeing the same charge twice doesn't always mean you were charged twice.

## Check if one is pending

Hotels, gas stations, car rentals and restaurants often place a temporary authorization, then post the final amount separately. The pending one usually drops off within 7 days. Pending transactions can't be disputed.

## If both have posted

If two identical charges have both posted, contact the merchant first. Most will refund a duplicate quickly. If the merchant doesn't help, dispute the second charge in the app as a duplicate. Tap the transaction, then Get help, then Charged

[travel-exchange-rates] Exchange rates we use (effective 2025-01-01)
When you pay in a foreign currency, we convert the amount to US dollars using the card network's exchange rate on the day the transaction settles. We don't add a markup to that rate.

## What you pay on top

Your plan's foreign transaction fee is added as a percentage of the converted amount:

- Basic: 3%
- Plus: 1%
- Premium: 0%

## Why the amount changes

A pending transaction shows an estimate based on the rate when you paid. The final amount uses the rate on the day it settles, usually a day or two later, so

[savings-round-ups] Round-ups (effective 2025-01-01)
Round-ups save your spare change. Each time you pay with your card, we round the purchase up to the next dollar and move the difference into a Savings Pocket you choose.

## Turn on round-ups

Tap Savings, choose a pocket, and switch on Round-ups.

## How it works

- Round-ups are added up during the day and moved once a day.
- Purchases that are already a whole dollar amount aren't rounded.
- Round-ups only apply to card purchases, not to ATM withdrawals, transfers or fees.
- If your main balance is too low, that day's round-up is

[fx-fees-plus-v1] Foreign transaction fees on Plus (effective 2025-01-01)
separate line in your activity feed, called "Foreign transaction fee", on the same day the purchase settles.

## Exchange rate

We use the card network's rate on the day the transaction settles, with no markup. Choose the local currency when a terminal offers to charge you in dollars.

## Refunds

If a foreign purchase is refunded, we also refund the foreign transaction fee on the refunded amount. The refund is converted at the rate on the day it settles.

If you travel often, Premium has no foreign transaction fee.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or

[card-declined] Why was my card declined? (effective 2025-01-01)
on Premium. Limits can't be raised except by changing plan.

## Card settings

Check that the card is activated and isn't frozen, and that the right controls are on. If international purchases are switched off, foreign merchants will decline, even for online orders.

## Fraud checks

If our systems think a purchase looks unusual, we decline it and send a fraud alert. Confirm the alert in the app and try again. If you don't answer, the card may stay locked.

## Where you are

Cards don't work in comprehensively sanctioned countries and regions.

[disputes-pending] Why can't I dispute a pending transaction? (effective 2025-01-01)
You can't dispute a transaction while it's still pending. A pending transaction is an authorization. The merchant hasn't collected the money yet, and the amount can still change or disappear.

## What to do

Wait for the transaction to post. Most pending transactions post or drop off within 7 days. Once it posts, the Dispute option appears when you tap it.

## If you don't recognize it

Freeze your card now, even though you can't dispute yet. That stops any more charges. When the transaction posts, dispute it as unauthorized. Your dispute

your activity feed, called "Foreign transaction fee", on the same day the purchase settles.

## Exchange rate

We use the card network's rate on the day the transaction settles, with no markup. Choose the local currency when a terminal offers to charge you in dollars.

## Refunds

If a foreign purchase is refunded, we also refund the foreign transaction fee on the refunded amount. The refund is converted at the rate on the day it settles.

If you travel often, Premium has no foreign transaction fee.
